About the house

Who we are

Founded by collectors Authenticity first Relationship-driven

Founded by Armando (AJ) Reyes Jr, a seasoned watch enthusiast and collector, our company is built on a foundation of trust, integrity, and a deep appreciation for craftsmanship. With a keen eye for rare and unique timepieces, AJ has spent years building relationships with collectors and dealers to source the finest watches for our clients.

We're passionate about timepieces. For years, we've been curating an exceptional collection of luxury watches, for discerning collectors and connoisseurs. Our mission is to provide an unparalleled buying experience, marked by expert knowledge, personalized service, and a commitment to authenticity.

Delta Timepieces

About us

We're a group of watch lovers who started Delta Timepieces back in 2020. We were tired of seeing people get ripped off by crazy markups at traditional jewelry stores. So, we decided to shake things up and make awesome timepieces more affordable for everyone.

Also, we're not affiliated with any big brands like Rolex or Omega. We're just a team of enthusiasts who want to share our passion for watches with the world. We source authentic timepieces and sell them to you at unbeatable prices. No fancy marketing gimmicks or inflated prices here - just great watches at fair prices.
